responsibility: This definition module declares the ARRAY OF CHAR interface for reading and modifying process environment variables in GNU Modula-2. It belongs to the runtime operating-system interface layer and exports GetEnvironment to copy an environment value into a caller buffer and PutEnvironment to submit a NAME=VALUE definition to the host environment.
same_name_distinction: This file is the interface declaration for raw ARRAY OF CHAR environment access, listing only GetEnvironment and PutEnvironment; the libc getenv/putenv bridge logic lives in Environment.mod.
